target: Vestas V90-2.0 MW, S01-era public-source reconstruction

unverified: 实际轴倾角、锥角与叶根偏置
齿轮齿数、传动比与齿形
轴承类型、内部滚动体及公差

tower_internals.source: S02 GridStreamer p81: cross-version facility reference only; not DFIG batch confirmation
tower_internals.scale: same as tower, no local enlargement

electrical_reconstruction.configuration: DFIG functional reconstruction; historical VCS reference; not GridStreamer
electrical_reconstruction.transformer_location: rear nacelle, historic brochure reference; exact geometry estimated
electrical_reconstruction.switchgear: optional, selected in this reconstruction; tower-bottom location estimated
electrical_reconstruction.energy_storage: DC-link capacitors only; no confirmed battery/UPS included
electrical_reconstruction.power_paths: stator to AC bus; rotor via bidirectional RSC/DC-link/GSC/filter to AC bus; transformer to tower MV cables, optional switchgear and collector interface
electrical_reconstruction.unverified: ratings, voltages, gear teeth, cable schedules, clearances, equipment sizes/counts, detailed circuit and exact batch

wind_sensor_reconstruction.configuration_source: S05, 2010 V90 VCS historical specification, p17 section 3.6
wind_sensor_reconstruction.limitations: 安装位置、外形、标高、支架和线缆均为示意；S01批次适用性未确认。

drivetrain_module.geometry: C functional envelopes; static intermediate gears
drivetrain_module.conflict: S01中文手册为两级行星+一级斜齿；本模块独立采用S05历史配置，不证明同批次一致。
drivetrain_module.animation: input and output shafts only; global slow motion scales time equally
